title: ClearPath Client Multiplier on Restart Change Order Fees — Professional Services Projects
content:
Clients of ClearPath Managed IT Services on the upper tiers pay a reduced administration fee on a restart change order of a Professional Services Projects engagement.

The administration fee of a restart change order is multiplied by 0.5 for a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, by 0.8 for one on the ClearPath Professional tier, and left unchanged for any other client.

| Client's ClearPath agreement in active status | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 0.5 |
| ClearPath Professional | 0.8 |
| ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard, or no agreement in active status | unchanged |

Hypothetical illustration: a fee of 400.00 for a ClearPath Professional client becomes 320.00 under this multiplier alone.
